steps.en: On one NVIDIA GPU, install deps, download data and train the tokenizer once
steps.zh: 在一块 NVIDIA 卡上装依赖，一次性下数据、训 tokenizer

steps.en: Write the research strategy the agent should follow
steps.zh: 写好要 agent 遵循的研究策略

steps.en: Start your own coding agent in the repo and point it at program.md
steps.zh: 在仓库里开你自己的 coding agent，让它读 program.md

steps.en: Opens a fresh run branch, edits train.py with one idea, commits
steps.zh: 开一条新运行分支，按一个想法改 train.py 并提交

steps.en: Trains for a fixed 5 minutes and reads val_bpb from the log
steps.zh: 固定训练 5 分钟，从日志读出 val_bpb

steps.en: Keeps the commit if val_bpb dropped, else resets; logs the row and loops
steps.zh: val_bpb 降了就保留提交，否则回退；记一行后继续循环

value.en: You wake up to ~100 logged experiments and a branch holding only the changes that lowered val_bpb
value.zh: 醒来时有约 100 条实验记录，分支上只留下让 val_bpb 变低的改动

sources: https://github.com/karpathy/autoresearch#quick-start (uv sync, uv run prepare.py, uv run train.py, single NVIDIA GPU)
https://github.com/karpathy/autoresearch#running-the-agent (spin up Claude/Codex, point it at program.md)
https://github.com/karpathy/autoresearch/blob/master/program.md (git checkout -b autoresearch/<tag>, uv run train.py > run.log 2>&1, results.tsv, keep/reset loop)
